purpose: Freeze schemas and launchers once the first implementation wave starts. Later edits require a schema_version bump plus a migration with a passing forward/back round-trip.
bump_rules: Any byte change to a frozen_paths entry requires schema_version increment in the governing document or freeze record.
A migration JSON must exist under migration_dir with forward and back transforms.
Round-trip on real pre-freeze sample data must be byte-identical after forward then back.
Edits outside frozen_paths and launcher_paths are SILENT.
